component.name: deckhud
component.summary: See your Steam Input radial menus, key chords and layers on the desktop

description.p: deckhud brings the Steam Deck's controller feedback to KDE Plasma's Desktop Mode, where Steam does not draw its own overlay. It shows translucent, click-through overlays tinted with your KDE accent colour:

ul.li: Radial menu HUD: see which radial item your stick is pointing at before you let go
Key-chord toasts: see which keys a button just sent, for example R4 → Meta + Shift + .
Layer cheat sheet: see what every control does when you switch action sets or hold a layer

description.p: deckhud reads your existing Steam Input layout and the controller's state; it never changes either. It needs KDE Plasma on Wayland and a Steam Deck's built-in controller.
First release: radial menu HUD, key-chord toasts and layer cheat sheet for KDE Plasma on Wayland.
